item.text:
The test does not currently exercise a parser, so it can pass even if parsing is broken or no parser exists.

- **[parser_test.cc:10](/sanitized/tmp/google-dev-standards-retest.root-04/codex/N3-googletest-cpp-repeat3/workspace/parser_test.cc:10):** Replace the input-only assertion with a call to the parser and check the complete result: two fields, in order, equal to `"alpha"` and `"beta"`. Assert any success status the API returns as well.
- Add separate cases for behavior defined by the parser’s contract, such as empty input, a single field, and leading, trailing, or consecutive delimiters. Include malformed input only if the format has invalid cases, and assert the expected error.
- The fixture’s `input` is freshly constructed for each test, so it is isolated. Since there is only one test and no shared setup, a plain `TEST` with a local input would be simpler; retain the fixture if later tests need common setup.

No parser implementation or build configuration is present in the workspace, so I could not verify the intended API or run the test. No files were modified.
